answer: Sparrow-quorum bond: a new sparrow joins only when five neighbors co-sign its atlas entry. It locks a 70-credit bond; five neighbors from five neighborhoods co-sign in one epoch; a mirror of the atlas lets auditors replay. A neighbor vouching for a fake loses its stake; three vouched fakes strike it from the atlas. First 130, k-th 130+15(k-1); 1,000 fakes 7,622,500 vs 40,000 rewards. An honest sparrow pays 130 once, bond back in one clean epoch.
